I2.quote: Super activated carbon was prepared by chemical activation in nitrogen at 1073 K, using KOH as the activating agent and litchi wood as the precursor.

I3.quote: The amount of hydrogen adsorption on the AC increased with increasing pressure and reached 2.56 wt.% and 0.41 wt.% at 77 K 0.1 MPa and at 303 K 5.7 MPa, respectively.

I4.location: main, p. 2 (journal p. 292), Section 3.1 Porous texture characterization; SBET for all six samples in Table 1

notes: Primary research article; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. Table 1 gives H2 uptake (wt.%) for six AC samples at 77 K/0.1 MPa and 303 K/5.7 MPa with BET areas (N2, 77 K, P/P0 0.05-0.3). Fig. 6 compares with pristine ACs of 750-3400 m2/g attributed to the authors' ref. [29], but the paper does not state that every uptake value was published before, so duplicate_data does not apply.
